events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: Sir Mick Jagger, the iconic frontman of The Rolling Stones, celebrates his 83rd birthday today, having captivated audiences for over six decades.

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young and still moving like Jagger! Wishing a very happy birthday to the legendary Rolling Stones frontman, Sir Mick Jagger.

events.title: MTV launched 45 years ago
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) first launched 45 years ago today, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' famously being the very first music video ever aired.

angles.name: Video Killed The Radio Star
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago, a new era began as MTV launched, forever changing how we consume music. And yes, the first video was indeed 'Video Killed The Radio Star' by The Buggles. Poetic, isn't it?

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis' groundbreaking debut album 'Definitely Maybe', featuring anthems like 'Live Forever' and 'Supersonic', was released 32 years ago in August 1994.

angles.name: Britpop Icon
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of a generation. What's your favourite track from this Britpop masterpiece?

events.title: Woodstock Festival 57th anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music and counterculture history, took place 57 years ago in August 1969.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years on, the spirit of peace, love, and three days of music lives on. Remembering the iconic Woodstock Festival that defined a generation.

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 49 years since the world lost the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Forty-nine years today, the music world paused as we said goodbye to Elvis Presley. His legacy as The King continues to inspire and entertain.

events.title: 30 years since Tupac Shakur's death
events.blurb: Today marks 30 years since the tragic passing of influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who was shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the world lost a lyrical genius. Remembering the enduring impact and powerful voice of Tupac Shakur.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's 56th death anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 56 years since the passing of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who died on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost a true icon. Remembering the unparalleled talent and revolutionary sound of Jimi Hendrix today.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album, featuring the famous zebra crossing cover, was released 57 years ago in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is as legendary as the music within it.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Legend
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon whose distinctive voice and style continue to inspire.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the outspoken and charismatic former frontman of Oasis, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK single turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK 51 years ago today, in October 1975, coinciding with his 'Shaved Fish' compilation. The song was originally released on his 1971 album and as a US single.

angles.name: Timeless Anthem
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since 'Imagine' became a UK single, John Lennon's message of peace and unity resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: First iPod released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod 25 years ago, on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music with '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: Tech Revolution
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped the original, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changing everything.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Day
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day – celebrating over six decades of espionage, gadgets, and iconic theme tunes.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today, we remember the visionary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering John
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're taking a moment to appreciate the enduring genius and message of peace from John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy icon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The White Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, diverse masterpiece, 'The White Album'. A double album like no other.
